data.notify_service: Phone notification service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone; empty = Home Assistant notifications only)

data_description.tariff_mode: Auto/dynamic: peak hours are computed every day from the buy entity's hourly price list (e.g. Pstryk). A day without a full price list uses the peak windows above.

inverter.title: Inverter (direct connection)
inverter.description: Experimental. Connects straight to the Solarman logger (port 8899) without the ha-solarman integration. A logger usually accepts only one local connection at a time, so for testing disable ha-solarman or remove its entry for this inverter. Writing to the inverter is off by default.

data.name: Name
data.host: Logger IP address or host name

data_description.allow_write: When off, the integration only reads. Turn on to let number / select / switch / time entities write to the inverter registers.

additional_options.name: Additional options
additional_options.description: Change only if the profile needs it (number of MPPT inputs, phases, battery packs…).

reconfigure.title: BMS komp-dec reconfiguration
reconfigure.description: Change entities and parameters. Saving reloads the integration (no need to remove it).

wizard.title: BMS komp-dec wizard
wizard.description: The wizard adds the inverter, waits for its entities to appear, matches them to the planner and saves everything. Writing to the inverter and auto-apply stay off until you enable them.

wizard_wait.title: Inverter is not responding yet
wizard_wait.description: The inverter is added and connected, but it has not returned its first readings yet (battery, PV, grid, load). This is normal for the first minute. Press Submit to check again. Nothing is added a second time.

abort.already_configured_device: An inverter with this address is already added.
abort.name_in_use: This name is already used by another inverter.

error.invalid_peaks: Invalid peak hours. Use the format 6-13,15-22 (whole hours, ascending, non-overlapping; "none" = flat tariff).
error.invalid_notify: Invalid service name. Use the format notify.mobile_app_phone (lowercase letters, digits, underscores).
error.cannot_connect: The host name could not be resolved.
error.timeout_connect: Timed out while resolving the host address.
error.already_configured_device: An inverter with this address is already added.
error.name_in_use: This name is already used by another inverter.
error.setup_failed: The inverter did not load in time. Check the logger IP address and port, and that nothing else (e.g. ha-solarman) holds its single connection. The entry was removed.
error.core_missing: The main entities are missing (SOC, PV, load, battery and grid power). Select them in the form.
error.entities_missing: The selected entities do not exist in Home Assistant: {problems}
error.wrong_type: Entities have the wrong type or unit: {problems}
error.no_data: The inverter is still not returning data. Check the logger IP address and port, wait a moment and submit again.
